reason: The police finding my son two streets away scared me enough that I'd consider almost anything. But a camera on his chest that I can open whenever I like feels like watching him rather than protecting him, and he deserves some dignity. I'd want to see it working before paying $249 plus $19.99 a month.
objection: An AirTag or a kids' watch does most of this for much less, and I don't want to be watching live video of my child all day. Who else can see that feed, and what happens to it?
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or money-back window where I can test the GPS and SOS alerts in real conditions, plus clear written limits on who can view the live video and when it is recorded.
